snippet.title: Nokia 3310 - Pairs II (Game Play)
snippet.description: Pairs II was a classic memory game featured on the Nokia 3310 phone. The objective was to find matching pairs by flipping cards one at a time and remembering their locations. It was a simple yet addictive way to test your memory and enjoy a retro gaming experience.
